comments.text: From facet_pi security audit Finding 1 (High): file_edit.ex:19 uses Path.expand(path, workspace) directly without calling Facet.PathSanitizer.sanitize/2. All other native tools call the sanitizer. Catseye already flags PathTraversal on File.read/write here via Sobelow, but misses the SPECIFIC pattern: a function in a project that has a PathSanitizer module calling Path.expand instead of the sanitizer. This is a cross-function validation gap. Detection approach: if the project defines a module with 'sanitize' in the name that wraps Path operations, flag any Path.expand/Path.join calls in other modules that don't route through the sanitizer.

title: Elixir: detect Path.expand used without PathSanitizer in projects that define a sanitizer module
